6996.title: Multiword mention sessions outlive empty results
6996.rootCauseOneLine: The composer never retires settled-empty multiword mention sessions, so space-preserving parsing keeps them active until the bounded scan drops the trigger boundary.
6996.proposedFix: Retire settled-empty multiword mention occurrences through the existing dismissal lifecycle, preserving pending searches, errors, local attachment matches, and valid multiword suggestions.
6996.caveats: Real composer DOM and parser behavior reproduced twice on Linux. Browser Automation was blocked by missing Chrome/Chromium; no screenshots or macOS validation. Repro source and significant output are inline; raw artifacts stay private under reports-repository policy.
